hero.title: Why Study Physiotherapy in Germany?
hero.subtitle: Germany offers globally respected Physiotherapy programmes (Physiotherapie) combining evidence-based rehabilitation science with extensive clinical hospital placements.

overview: Germany provides high-quality academic and clinical training in Physiotherapy at leading Universities of Applied Sciences (Hochschulen) and teaching hospitals, with low or zero tuition at public institutions.
Edu-Hawk Worldwide Consultancy guides Indian students through German language pathways, university admission criteria, credential evaluation, and student visa processing.
